rules.helps: win z >= 2 with share z > -2, or share z >= 2 with win z > -2
rules.shape: one screen: a source whose profile is not `screen` above is marked legacy and kept as history; new ones are refused
rules.win_column: wins added per 10,000 on-arm seats at the gene's measured on-rate in one source, (win_on - 1/players) * 10000; last, prior and third are the three most recent sources that priced the gene, newest first, so a new source shifts last to prior and prior to third; they are published evidence - the default reads batch_columns, not these
rules.win_diff: the pooled on rate minus the pooled off rate in percentage points, over every screen that priced the gene, each weighted by its on-arm seats - the ranking's `Diff`, the whole on-off difference
rules.default_on: operator-retained-selection: each gene's completed-total-seat-weighted average over its available readings from the latest three reporting batches, in wins per 10,000 total seats, decides it with hysteresis against the previous published selection (prior_deployment_genome): a gene currently off turns on only strictly above +3; a gene currently on stays on unless strictly below -3, and a gene currently on that no batch priced keeps its default; when multiple versions of one gene qualify, only the version with the higher such average ships (ties to the higher version); every other screenable gene is off; exactly the tags in deployment_genome are on, a reselection reads the previous published selection from prior_deployment_genome, and a reporting-only batch refresh retains the selected set while its batch columns remain published evidence
rules.batch_rule: read over the reporting batches that priced the gene, newest first, at most batch_rule_window of them, each reading the ranking's wins +- per 10,000 total seats: (1) three batches all below batch_rule_remove_below -> remove the gene from the pool; (2) two or three batches negative -> off; (3) three batches all positive -> on; (4) three batches, exactly two positive, mean > batch_rule_average -> on; (5) one or two batches, exactly one positive, mean > batch_rule_average -> on; (6) two batches both positive -> on; (7) otherwise off - no batch, or a zero, is neither positive nor negative
rules.retained_selection_hysteresis: a gene in prior_deployment_genome stays selected unless its weighted average is strictly below retained_selection_off_below; a gene outside it is selected only strictly above retained_selection_min_average; hysteresis_held lists the selected genes whose average does not clear retained_selection_min_average - on because they were already on, or because a reporting-only rotation retained them
rules.operator_pins: the genes the operator named by hand (genes.py OPERATOR_DEFAULT_ON and OPERATOR_DEFAULT_OFF, 2026-08-26); the pinned ones are in the retained deployment_genome and the held ones are out of it, while batch_decisions records what the batch rule would say as evidence; the current selection has no manual pins or holds
rules.posterior: random-effects (DerSimonian-Laird) inverse-variance pool of every screen's on-off difference on the win column's scale, each weighted by its own standard error and the between-screen variance carried in the interval; posterior_pp is the pooled effect and posterior_se_pp its standard error, both in wins per 10,000 on-arm seats
rules.versions: every version's batch-rule reading remains recorded on its own row; this reporting-only rotation retains the already selected version, one per family, while a family still holds at most 3 versions and a fourth requires a cull of the third-best
rules.deployment_policy_meaning: a reporting-only table refresh retains the preceding deployment_genome; each gene's completed-total-seat-weighted average over its available readings from the latest three reporting batches, in wins per 10,000 total seats, decides it with hysteresis against the previous published selection (prior_deployment_genome): a gene currently off turns on only strictly above +3; a gene currently on stays on unless strictly below -3, and a gene currently on that no batch priced keeps its default; when multiple versions of one gene qualify, only the version with the higher such average ships (ties to the higher version); every other screenable gene is off. The new batch columns are evidence and cannot change a default
